component_results.result: On the exact U=0 eight-valley source, the same natural exterior-shell states have genuine regional modular exponential domains, a uniform O((R/L)^6) relative-entropy bound at fixed amplitude, and an exact leading nonlinear coefficient. For each original normalized directional shell, chi(0)/(R/L)^6 tends to 64 c_gamma^2/(35 pi^2) and D(theta)/(R/L)^6 tends uniformly on compact amplitude intervals to 32 c_gamma^2 theta^2/(35 pi^2). A common positive lattice mesh gives the same finite-density limits. All 81 observer-frame preparations have normalized finite-amplitude entropy response converging to the existing nine-direction matrix with O((R/L)^2) error. The nonlinear correction is o(R^4) at fixed L; no area or stationarity law is introduced.
remaining: Source-derived responsive area/edge identification, Newton normalization and generalized-entropy stationarity on the same geometry and matter family.
A sharply boosted finite lattice regional algebra and common geometric chart construction; the present frame changes are prepared states on rest balls.
A nonzero-U finite-amplitude entropy theorem and the required interacting relativistic particle sectors.
Native shell preparation and entropy readout with practical, complete-output resource and error bounds.

quantifier_boundary: Free-sector matter entropy is o(R^4) at fixed shell scale L, or R^2/L^6 tending to zero. Source-derived area response and stationarity remain open. Native filtered readout is constructive but not efficient; its infinite ordered input still requires an effective preparation modulus. Current identities do not prove first-energy tightness, a sharp mass shell, physical species or a surviving interacting relativistic sector.
